description: This Java source file defines a class SingleLoanChargeRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper in the package org.apache.fineract.portfolio.loanaccount.domain. It provides functionality to process and reprocess loan repayment schedules, including calculations for charges, fees, penalties, and accruals related to loan repayment installments.

classes.name: SingleLoanChargeRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around loan schedule related data exposing needed behaviour by loan, including methods to reprocess schedules and calculate charges.

methods.name: reprocess
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the repayment schedule for a loan based on charges, interest, principal, and other factors.

methods.name: calcChargeDue
methods.description: Calculates the amount of a charge that is due within a period, considering various charge and loan attributes.

methods.name: calcChargeWaived
methods.description: Calculates the amount of a charge that has been waived during a period.

methods.name: calcChargeWrittenOff
methods.description: Calculates the amount of a charge that has been written off during a period.

methods.name: getInstallmentFee
methods.description: Calculates the installment fee amount based on the charge's calculation method.

methods.name: getBaseAmount
methods.description: Determines the base amount for charge calculations, considering principal and interest.

methods.name: addChargeOnlyRepaymentInstallmentIfRequired
methods.description: Adds a repayment installment for a charge without an existing corresponding schedule entry if required.
